help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions and learn how to use YogduOJ
help.q_register: How do I register an account?
help.a_register: Click the Register button in the top navigation bar. Fill in your username, email, and password. Your username must be 4-16 alphanumeric characters. Your password must be at least 8 characters and contain both letters and numbers.
help.a_login: Click the Login button in the top navigation bar. Enter your username and password. You can check "Remember me" to stay logged in. If you forgot your password, click "Forgot password?" to reset it.
help.q_profile: How do I edit my profile?
help.a_profile: After logging in, click your username in the top navigation bar and select Profile. From there you can update your avatar URL, change your password, and view your statistics. Note that your username can only be changed once.
help.q_browseProblems: How do I browse and find problems?
help.a_browseProblems: Navigate to the Problems page from the top navigation. You can filter problems by type (Programming, Algorithm, CTF), difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), and tags. Use the search bar to find problems by ID or title. Click on a problem to view its details.
help.q_submitCode: How do I submit code for a problem?
help.a_browseProblems: Open the problem you want to solve. Write your solution in the built-in code editor. Select your preferred programming language from the dropdown. Click Submit Code to submit your solution. The judge will evaluate your code against all test cases.
help.q_understandResults: How do I understand judge results?
help.a_understandResults:
Judge results include:
  • Accepted (AC): Your solution passed all test cases.
  • Wrong Answer (WA): Your output does not match the expected output.
  • Time Limit Exceeded (TLE): Your code took too long to run.
  • Memory Limit Exceeded (MLE): Your code used too much memory.
  • Runtime Error (RE): Your code crashed during execution.
  • Compilation Error (CE): Your code could not be compiled.
help.q_participate: How do I participate in a contest?
help.a_participate: Go to the Contests page and find a contest. If the contest is upcoming, click Register to sign up. Once the contest starts, click Enter Contest to access the problems. Solve problems within the contest time window to earn points and improve your ranking.
help.a_contestRules:
Contest rules depend on the rule type:
  • ACM (ICPC): Ranked by problems solved, with penalty time for wrong submissions.
  • OI: Scored based on test cases passed, with partial scoring.
  • Codeforces: Dynamic scoring that decreases as more participants solve each problem.
Always read the contest description for specific rules.
help.a_rankings: Rankings are updated in real-time during contests. In ACM mode, participants are ranked by problems solved (descending) and penalty time (ascending). In OI mode, participants are ranked by total score (descending). Some contests may freeze the leaderboard near the end to prevent score chasing.
help.q_createTeam: How do I create a team?
help.a_createTeam: Navigate to the Teams page and click Create Team. Fill in the team name, description, and slogan. You will automatically become the team leader. You can then invite other members by their username.
help.q_joinTeam: How do I join a team?
help.a_joinTeam: Go to the Teams page and browse available teams. Click on a team to view its details. If the team has open invitations or allows joining, you can request to join. The team leader must approve your request.
help.q_manageTeam: How do I manage my team?
help.a_manageTeam:
As a team leader, you can:
  • Invite new members by username
  • Remove existing members
  • Update team name, description, and slogan
  • Disband the team (this action is irreversible)
Go to your team's detail page to access these options.
help.a_ctfCategories:
YogduOJ offers the following CTF challenge categories:
  • Reverse Engineering: Analyze binaries and executables
  • Pwn: Exploit memory corruption vulnerabilities
  • Web: Web application security
  • Cryptography: Break encryption and encoding schemes
  • Forensics: Digital artifact analysis
  • Miscellaneous: Steganography, OSINT, puzzles
  • Reconnaissance: Information gathering
  • Vulnerability Reproduce: Reproduce real CVEs
help.q_submitFlag: How do I submit a flag for CTF challenges?
help.a_submitFlag: For CTF problems, instead of submitting code, you submit a flag. The flag is typically in the format flag{...} or YogduOJ{...}. Enter the flag in the flag input field and click Submit Flag. If correct, the problem will be marked as solved.
help.a_supportedLanguages: YogduOJ supports a variety of programming languages including: C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Rust, JavaScript, and more. The exact list may vary. Check the language dropdown in the code editor when submitting a solution to see all available options.
help.q_timeLimit: What are the time and memory limits?
help.a_timeLimit: Each problem specifies its own time limit (usually 1-5 seconds) and memory limit (usually 128-512 MB). These limits are displayed on the problem page. Your solution must run within these limits on all test cases to be accepted.
help.q_cheatPolicy: What is the policy on cheating?
help.a_cheatPolicy:
YogduOJ takes cheating very seriously. The following actions are strictly prohibited:
  • Copying code from other participants
  • Sharing solutions during contests
  • Using multiple accounts
  • Collaborating during individual contests
Violations may result in score penalties, account suspension, or permanent bans.
help.q_reportBug: How do I report a bug or issue?
help.a_reportBug: If you encounter a bug or issue with YogduOJ, please contact the administrators through the system. Provide a detailed description of the issue, including steps to reproduce it, the problem or contest ID, and any screenshots if applicable. The team will investigate and resolve the issue as soon as possible.
